steps.name: Assert Step picker + Comments both mandatory
PLAN DEVIATION — picker offers ALL completed steps, not Register/Certify only
Select "Capture and Link Invoice on LOGIS" + comment → OK
Assert Pre-Authorise reverted (status 5), Capture and Link active again
Assert Payment Number retained but proceed-choice cleared
Re-capture with Yes → Pre-Authorise → Verify Voucher
BAS report (HB821, INV) + payment stub (PO OR-126152) → PAID
